system.description:
Grants a bonus on rolls to notice nearby hidden objects or ambushes.

  • Level 1: +2 Stat roll awareness bonus
  • Level 2: +4 Stat roll awareness bonus
  • Level 3: +6 Stat roll awareness bonus
  • Level 4: +8 Stat roll awareness bonus
  • Level 5: +10 Stat roll awareness bonus
  • Level 6: +12 Stat roll awareness bonus
